children: said on Tuesday its President and CEO Greg Ebel will retire at the end of 2026, and insider Michele Harradence will succeed him as chief executive effective January 1 next year.
Harradence is currently head of its gas distribution and storage business.
Ebel joined Enbridge in 2017, following the company's acquisition of Spectra Energy. He became Enbridge's president and CEO in January 2023.
